items.followUp: Explain a truth table and give an example for an OR gate.

rubric.why: A truth table shows the output for every possible combination of inputs.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it shows outputs for all possible input combinations.

rubric.why: The example must give the correct output for every input combination of an AND gate.
rubric.description: Give a correct example truth table.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the AND gate and giving all four correct input-output rows.

modelAnswer: A truth table is a table that shows the output of a logic gate for every possible combination of its inputs.
